title: Halogens as oxidising agents
caption: The more positive the standard electrode potential, the more strongly the halogen pulls in electrons: fluorine is the strongest oxidising agent and iodine the weakest. So chlorine displaces bromide and iodide, but iodine displaces neither.
alt: Bar chart of E° for X₂/X⁻: F₂ +2.87, Cl₂ +1.36, Br₂ +1.09, I₂ +0.54 V.
